azure-ai-103-s2.3-10.statement: An outgoing AgentExecutor edge condition receives the generated response text as a string.
azure-ai-103-s2.3-10.explanation: An AgentExecutor sends an AgentExecutorResponse to its outgoing edge condition. Routing code reads message.agent_response.text when it needs the generated text.
azure-ai-103-s2.3-10.misconception: A conditional routing callback receives the agent's plain response text instead of its response object.
